Class Generator

java.lang.Object
smile.onnx.genai.Generator
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, Iterable<Integer>
public final class Generator extends Object implements AutoCloseable, Iterable<Integer>
Autoregressive token generator. Canonical loop: 
generator.appendTokens(promptTokens);
try (var stream = tokenizer.createStream()) {
    while (!generator.isDone()) {
        generator.generateNextToken();
        String chunk = stream.decode(generator.getLastToken(0));
    }
}

Also implements IterableInteger> so callers can write for (int token : generator).
